purpose: Thematic decorative hero imagery for 11 rental detail pages; not evidence of a specific machine in the RemSD fleet.

variants.prompt:
Create a NEW photorealistic industrial editorial photograph for the hero of a Russian heavy-equipment rental/service page. The first reference is ONLY the established photographic style, natural lighting and colour palette; do not copy its three-machine lineup. ULTRAWIDE PANORAMIC composition, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio (about 2176x736 or 3072x1024). One coherent believable photograph, natural full-scale machinery, no toy-like CGI.

Match the restrained cool steel-blue early-morning sky, distant northern treeline, quiet industrial setting, yellow machinery and realistic graphite/steel materials. Use soft natural light with a little warm light on the equipment, not theatrical flares. Keep the LEFT 50 percent of the frame empty and low-contrast (sky, ground and distant unobtrusive background) for the website heading. The COMPLETE main subject and all important attachments must fit between x=53% and x=95%, y=20% and y=78%, with visible sky and ground margins. Camera far enough away that wheels/tracks, booms, blades, buckets and load are not cut off. A right-half crop will be used for the phone version, so no essential subject part may cross x=50%. No close-up foreground objects. Do not put scenery, signs or bright clutter behind the left-side text area.

SUBJECT:
A single full-size yellow truck-mounted TELESCOPIC MOBILE CRANE, four-axle 8x8 carrier, separate operator cab and driving cab, long straight telescopic boom completely retracted and stowed HORIZONTALLY over the carrier, with small hook block lowered close to the front. Parked on a level industrial hardstand, all tires visible, no load suspended. This must be a mobile crane, not a knuckle-boom flatbed or crawler crane.

No people, text, manufacturer logos, model numbers, labels, watermarks, website graphics, painted gradients or collage panels. The site adds its own dark overlay; keep the photo naturally exposed and readable. Mechanical anatomy, grounded tires/tracks, shadows, hydraulics and perspective must be convincing. Make the subject easy to recognize at small website size.
